features: Massive 5000mAh Battery: Stay powered throughout the day with the 5000mAh battery, so you can browse, stream and stay connected without frequent charging.

Faster Performance & Ample Storage: Powered by an Octa-Core UNISOC processor, paired with 2GB RAM + 4GB Memory Fusion and 64GB internal storage, providing smoother multitasking and space for thousands of photos, videos and apps.
Smooth 90Hz HD+ Display: Enjoy fluid scrolling and vibrant visuals on the 6.6-inch HD+ IPS Display with a 90Hz refresh rate, perfect for social media, videos and everyday entertainment.
Military Grade Durability: Built to handle everyday drops and rough usage with Military Grade Protection, offering superior durability and long-lasting reliability for your daily adventures.
Immersive DTS Sound: Experience rich and immersive audio with DTS Sound Effect, delivering theatre-like sound quality for music, movies and gaming.

Smart Features for Everyday Convenience: Comes with Ultra Link for phone-to-phone communication beyond network coverage, IR Remote to control compatible home appliances, Side Fingerprint & Face Unlock, and the latest Android 15 Go Edition for a smarter smartphone experience.
description: The itel Zeno 100 Lite is designed to deliver dependable everyday performance with a premium look and feel. Equipped with a UNISOC Octa-Core Processor, 5000mAh battery, 6.6-inch 90Hz HD+ display, and immersive DTS Sound, it offers a smooth experience for work, entertainment and daily communication. With 2GB RAM, 64GB storage, a stylish crystal-texture finish, and secure Side Fingerprint & Face Unlock, the Zeno 100 Lite combines performance, style and reliability at an affordable price.
